title: Algerian Tagine with Acrid Flavor
description: A traditional Algerian dish with a twist, featuring a unique acrid flavor and served with a side of steamed vegetables. Perfect for a gluten-free meal.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: firm, drained and cut into 1-inch cubes

ingredients.name: Acrid spice
ingredients.notes: use a combination of ground ginger and cumin

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the Algerian spice blend, acrid spice, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the tofu and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomato and cook for another 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
Serve with a side of steamed vegetables, such as broccoli or carrots.
